negative_results: THE LEVER ITSELF, at a ceiling rather than a point estimate. There is no gating rule that recovers anything from S6 because there is nothing to gate: the oracle that picks the better of the two drafters per verify equals the MTP alone, exactly.

THE MECHANISM, and it is structural rather than prompt-specific: SPECULATION HANDS A RETRIEVAL DRAFTER ITS WORST POSSIBLE QUERY. The anchor a draft starts from is always the CORRECTION token -- the one token the MTP just mispredicted -- because whenever the sequence is locally predictable the MTP accepts straight through it. The anchor is therefore SELECTED to be the least repetitive token in the sequence. mlen=0 in 13 of 21 verifies: not even the current token had ever occurred before. New trap 27.

THE FAVOURABLE-CASE POINT. This was measured on a PERIOD-8 DEGENERATE REPEATING decode (16 455 6102 294 X 344 Y), the best input a prompt-lookup drafter can be handed. Where a long match did exist it only ever proposed the previous cycle's value of the one slot that varies (16603 vs 14251, 29585 vs 25062, 3702 vs 17705), because the deterministic part of the repeat is precisely what the MTP already accepts.
SIX RESEARCH QUERIES, FOUR OF WHICH FOUND NOTHING USABLE, all recorded. The expert-prefetch literature (four papers) assumes a CPU/disk->GPU transfer this engine does not have.

note_for_executor: YOU CANNOT RUN GIT -- write .flywheel_commit_msg and stop; the harness commits and the auditor publishes. Read LEVERS.md and RESEARCH_LOG.md first. ATTRIBUTE BEFORE OPTIMISING. TWO NEW RULES FROM F80: (1) PRICE A LEVER AS A COUNTED INTEGER WHERE YOU CAN -- acceptance has no variance floor, which is the only reason S6 was resolvable at all under the 1.5% cross-run timing floor, and a read-only counterfactual probe priced it from ONE checkpoint load without building the cascade. Prefer measuring a CEILING (an oracle over both arms) to measuring a point estimate: a ceiling of zero closes a lever permanently. (2) DO NOT PASS ONE ARGUMENT TO EVERY GATE BINARY -- 'for g in build/gate_*; do $g ref/goldens; done' produces four red gates that are all artefacts; only gate_units wants that path. Re-run a red gate on its own default before believing it, and never use that as cover for a gate that is red on its own defaults.

pivot_criterion.why: S5 (draft-head re-alignment) is a TRAINING job the autonomous loop cannot do. Kernel work and training compete for the same operator attention, so the loop must say plainly when kernel work has stopped paying rather than grinding sub-1% levers forever.
pivot_criterion.trigger: PIVOT when open_nontraining_levers == 0 on TWO consecutive audits, OR when three consecutive cycles adopt nothing >=1%. Either fires -> the auditor writes a PIVOT banner to FLYWHEEL_AUDIT.md and creates FLYWHEEL_PIVOT.

S6 is retired (F80, oracle ceiling +0.0%) and B8-cpasync -- promoted this cycle by the research phase on new evidence against F78's specific measurement -- takes its place as the only open, >=1%, non-training, no-constraint-relaxed item. position_at_definition.reading: The remaining kernel headroom is ~30% and is spread across many sub-1% items; the acceptance multiplier alone is worth 1.4x. When the kernel queue empties, the pivot is not a defeat -- it is the point where the larger lever becomes the only lever.
